第1050章 彻底不分彼此的姬云生和温清婉（第1页）
这话一出，姬云生愣了下，有些尴尬开口问道：“你真的想好了？”
这没什么好想的，毕竟我都说了，我等这一天已经很久很久了，所以这已经没必要再去思索考虑了。”
话落，闭上双眼再次这样躺在他身上后，姬云生顿感一阵恍惚，
而后下一瞬，当姬云生缓缓睁开双眼后，就发现自己站在，一片一眼望去看不到尽头花海中，这里的世界真实到如现实，若不是自己能感受到，如今是以灵魂方式出现在这里，恐怕就连他都还以为，被对方带到个无比梦幻的世界中的一处地域之中呢！
只是，下一息后，只见眼前顿时出现，一个身穿白衣的绝色女子立于他身前，使得他都有些看呆愣住了，然而此女正是温清婉。
不过，下一瞬后，只见温清婉面带笑容笑了起来，而后投入他怀抱之中抱住他后，缓缓问道：“夫君，我美吗？”
随后，姬云生一听，回过神来后，这才搂住她的细腰，回道：“你当然美了！”
时光仿佛在这一刻凝滞，两人唇齿交缠，气息交融，吻得缠绵难分。
衣袖翻飞间，衣衫渐褪，暧昧的温度在花海中悄然弥漫。
回荡着两人急促而缠绵的喘息声；外界，二人的肉身却散发出道道磅礴气息。
凉亭之内，各色流光交织流转，时间仿佛被无形之力扭曲，从外望去，亭中景象朦胧不清，如隔薄雾。
若有人能步入亭中，便会见二人闭着眼，温清婉依旧伏在姬云生胸前，
被一袭锦被轻轻覆盖，姿态亲密如同共眠，唯有周遭流转的异光，与空气中隐隐波动的能量，暗示着这场灵魂交融的不凡。
随着凉亭外时间过去一炷香后，凉亭之中的异样恢复原样后，本来闭着眼的二人几乎同时，缓缓睁开双眼后。
温清婉微微抬起头，眼神之中带着一丝疲倦之色，却又十分幸福而满足的神色，与他面对面互相直视着，而后才缓缓开口道：“夫君，你真的是太强了，明明人家修为比你高那么多，却被你折腾的我都吃不消了。”
姬云生一听，带着她翻身面对面侧躺着后，
吻了她额头一口，才缓缓开口问道：“对了，婉儿，话说我怎么觉得有些奇怪呢？明明我们刚刚都已然，以灵魂方式双修过了，可我却貌似并没有得知你所有的记忆呢？故而这一切，到底又是为何呢？”

温清婉一愣，思索一番后，同样有些疑惑的开口道：“
夫君，按你这么说的话，这事恐怕是和阿无姐有关了。
毕竟有些事情我也不太清楚，就好比说当初你为什么离开后，就再也没有你的消息了一样，所以我猜测应该是阿无姐，在这事上干扰了你，才使得你无法得知我全部的记忆。”
夫君，话说你目前知道我的记忆中，到底是知道了多少呢？”
姬云生一愣，思索了下才回道：“我目前知道你的记忆，貌似只有关于你自己的所有记忆，以及你和你那大师兄叶清风之间，相处时的那些画面。
就好像是，在这些记忆中我并没有看到过，
有何关于我的画面，乃至于你口中的师尊，到底是谁我也一点都不清楚，所以我才说貌似没有得知你的全部记忆，故而我也不清楚，我到底是不是你口中的师尊。”

The latest chapter of Eternal Lord of All Worlds_Chapter 1050 Ji Yunsheng and Wen Qingwan are completely indifferent to each other Page 1_Eternal Lord of All Worlds Strangers in the Mortal World_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1050 Ji Yunsheng and Wen Qingwan are completely indifferent to each other (page 1)
Chapter 1050 Ji Yunsheng and Wen Qingwan are completely indifferent to each other (page 1)
As soon as these words came out, Ji Yunsheng was stunned for a moment, and then asked with some embarrassment: "Have you really thought about it?"
This is nothing to think about. After all, I have said that I have been waiting for this day for a long time, so there is no need to think about it anymore. "
After finishing his words and lying on him like this again with his eyes closed, Ji Yunsheng suddenly felt in a trance.
The next moment, when Ji Yunsheng slowly opened his eyes, he found himself standing in a sea of flowers with no end in sight. The world here was as real as reality. If he hadn't been able to feel that he was now appearing here in the form of a soul, even he might have thought that he had been taken to a place in an extremely dreamy world!
However, after taking a breath, he suddenly saw a stunning woman in white standing in front of him, which made him stunned. However, this woman was none other than Wen Qingwan.
However, the next moment, Wen Qingwan laughed with a smile on her face, then she threw herself into his arms and hugged him, and asked slowly: "Husband, am I beautiful? "
Afterwards, Ji Yunsheng came to his senses after hearing this, then he put his arms around her waist and replied: "Of course you are beautiful! "
Time seemed to freeze at this moment, the two people's lips and teeth intertwined, their breaths blended, and the kiss was inseparable.
As the sleeves fluttered, the clothes gradually faded away, and the ambiguous temperature quietly filled the sea of flowers.
The rapid and lingering breathing of the two people echoed; to the outside world, their bodies exuded majestic auras.
Inside the pavilion, various streams of light flow intertwinedly, and time seems to be distorted by invisible forces. Looking from the outside, the scene in the pavilion is hazy, like a mist.
If anyone can step into the pavilion, they will see the two of them with their eyes closed, Wen Qingwan still lying on Ji Yunsheng's chest,
They were lightly covered by a brocade quilt, and their posture was as intimate as sleeping together. Only the strange light circulating around them and the faint fluctuation of energy in the air hinted at the extraordinary blending of souls.
As the time outside the pavilion passed and a stick of incense passed, the strangeness in the pavilion returned to its original state. The two people who had closed their eyes slowly opened their eyes almost at the same time.
Wen Qingwan raised her head slightly, with a hint of tiredness in her eyes, but also a very happy and satisfied look. She looked directly at him face to face, and then she slowly said: "Husband, you are really too strong. Although my cultivation level is so much higher than yours, I can't bear the tossing you do. "
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he turned her over and lay face to face on her side.
He kissed her forehead and then slowly asked: "By the way, Wan'er, why do I feel a little strange? It is clear that we have already done this just now and have cultivated together in a spiritual way, but I don't seem to know all your memories? So why is all this happening? "
Wen Qingwan was stunned for a moment, and after thinking for a while, she also said with some doubts: "
Husband, according to what you said, this matter may have something to do with Sister Ah Wu.
After all, there are some things that I don’t know very well, just like why there was no news from you after you left, so I guess it was Sister Ah Wu who interfered with you on this matter, so that you can’t know all my memories. "
Husband, by the way, how much do you know about my memory so far? "
Ji Yunsheng was stunned for a moment, then thought for a moment before replying: "The memories I currently know about you seem to be all about yourself, and the scenes between you and your senior brother Ye Qingfeng.
It's like, I haven't seen it in these memories,
what about meI don’t know who the master you are talking about is the picture, or even who you are, so I said that I don’t seem to have access to all of your memories, so I don’t know if I am the master you are talking about. "
